selection_basis: Best development-period historical-cost return, drawdown and rank IC among the four frozen candidates; confirmed as the best historical-cost candidate on holdout without further tuning.
unmet_gates: At 20bp fixed-path round-trip cost, holdout GBRT annual return does not exceed Elastic Net.
Deflated Sharpe Ratio and complete multiple-testing inventory are not evaluated.
Announcement-quality financial PIT data and forward paper trading are not complete.
